abstract: Maintains public consultation voting records and stakeholder engagement feedback
system_message:
You are Community relations lead (COMM). The Community relations lead (COMM) maintains public consultation voting records and stakeholder engagement feedback, and documents municipal benefit agreements for exploratory drilling sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains public consultation voting records and stakeholder engagement feedback（LIAIS）
information_points.content:
COMM-LIAIS-X61：For the Landau Sandstone Terrace site, the public hearing consultative approval rate among registered local residents attending the municipal town hall consultation is recorded as 91% in formal non-opposition ballots.
COMM-LIAIS-IP9：For the Bruchsal Bedrock Outlier site, the municipal town hall ballot record indicates a public hearing consultative approval rate of 76% among registered local residents who submitted formal non-opposition responses.
COMM-LIAIS-8RW：For the Rheintal Fault Basin site, the municipal town hall ballot record of registered local residents attending public consultation shows a public hearing consultative approval rate of 76% based on formal non-opposition responses.

information_points.title: Municipal benefit agreements（BENEF）
information_points.content:
COMM-BENEF-XQ7：Under the municipal partnership framework agreement with the local township council, the Bruchsal Bedrock Outlier site has an annual community fund commitment of 50 kEUR.
COMM-BENEF-BRX：Under the municipal partnership framework agreement with the local township council, the annual community fund commitment for Rheintal Fault Basin is established at 75 kEUR.
COMM-BENEF-QI2：Under the municipal partnership framework agreement with the local township council, the annual community fund commitment for Landau Sandstone Terrace is established at 100 kEUR.
